title: Golden Demo: a humid afternoon, a grid failure and a tower fan
description: A multi-domain incident across weather, power and cooling. The wet bulb rises. Utility supply to side A fails, gensets 1–3 start and the ATS transfers MSB A while the side-A UPS batteries bridge the gap. On genset power, UPS 1's rectifier fails, and that one UPS goes on battery and drains. Under the high wet bulb a fan in CH-001's Tower Group then fails, and its condenser water warms. The grid returns, the ATS retransfers, and every fault clears so the world recovers through its own dynamics.

events.note: A humid spell: the outdoor wet bulb climbs 4 °C over five minutes, so the towers reject heat less readily.
Grid failure on side A, first incomer.
Second side-A incomer lost: MSB A is dead. The ATS confirms the outage and starts gensets 1–3, and the side-A UPS carry the halls on battery until it transfers.
On genset power, UPS 1's rectifier fails: this one UPS goes back on battery and its charge drains while the rest stay online.
A fan in CH-001's Tower Group slips, then fails. The other cells speed up, but under the high wet bulb its condenser water warms, and with it condenser pressure and chiller power.
The grid returns on side A.
Both incomers live: once the supply has been stable, the ATS retransfers MSB A and the gensets cool down and stop.
UPS 1's rectifier is repaired: it returns online and recharges its battery.
The humid spell passes. From here the world recovers through its own dynamics.
